## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The validator rejects fixtures with an uncited root cause, a root cause...

The system SHALL ensure that the validator rejects fixtures with an uncited root cause, a root cause contradicted by a recorded fact, and a root cause with any unknown cell against a recorded fact.

#### Scenario: The validator rejects fixtures with an uncited root cause, a root cause...

WHEN `add-hypothesis-fact-matrix-and-root-cause-gate-to-validator` is implemented
THEN The validator rejects fixtures with an uncited root cause, a root cause contradicted by a recorded fact, and a root cause with any unknown cell against a recorded fact.

### Requirement: The validator emits the matrix with per-signal hypothesis counts and flags...

The system SHALL ensure that the validator emits the matrix with per-signal hypothesis counts and flags the all-consistent rows.

#### Scenario: The validator emits the matrix with per-signal hypothesis counts and flags...

WHEN `add-hypothesis-fact-matrix-and-root-cause-gate-to-validator` is implemented
THEN The validator emits the matrix with per-signal hypothesis counts and flags the all-consistent rows.

### Requirement: The necessity check fails a combined hypothesis when removing one component...

The system SHALL ensure that the necessity check fails a combined hypothesis when removing one component leaves no fact unexplained.

#### Scenario: The necessity check fails a combined hypothesis when removing one component...

WHEN `add-hypothesis-fact-matrix-and-root-cause-gate-to-validator` is implemented
THEN The necessity check fails a combined hypothesis when removing one component leaves no fact unexplained.
